strengths: Well-motivated problem: clearly identifies and addresses the overlooked role of initial noise sample optimization in training-free diffusion-based inpainting

Comprehensive experimental validation: three datasets (FFHQ, DIV2K, BrushBench), multiple baselines, human preference study (90% preference, N=37 raters), quantitative metrics, and extensive ablations (Table 4) demonstrating necessity of each component
